icons.prompt: Create one game inventory icon, isolated, centered on a square canvas with generous 10% padding, full silhouette visible. Match the approved berry smoothie icon and beach kiosk concept: polished smooth hand-drawn cartoon with bold dark warm brown outline, rounded forms, vibrant beach palette, clean flat cel shading with 3-4 tones, simple highlights from upper left, charming sunny tone, three-quarter front view slightly from above. Large simple details readable at 48 pixels. Transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow, no badge, no border, no words, no logos, no watermark. No pixelation, no photorealism. Image 1 is the approved tonic water icon (identity of the drink), image 2 the approved mint candies icon (identity of the mint), image 3 the approved berry smoothie icon (style and glass proportions). Create ONE new icon: a mojito-style drink, a tall clear tapered glass (same glass shape and proportions as the berry smoothie icon) filled with sparkling aqua-blue tonic water with a few clear ice cubes and tiny bubbles, a generous bunch of fresh bright green mint leaves with a sprig sticking out of the top, one thin lime wheel on the rim and one bent golden-yellow straw. Mint leaves large and simple, with a lighter green vein; keep the same aqua blue of the tonic water icon.

Create one game inventory icon for Granita al Limone Aromatizzata, isolated and centered on a 1254 × 1254 transparent square canvas with the full silhouette visible. Image 1 is the plain lemon granita icon and the exact visual base, image 2 is a rosemary shape reference, and image 3 is the icon style reference. Preserve image 1's composition, scale, warm dark-brown outline, broad cel shading, and pale lemon-yellow crushed ice with ivory glints. Keep its wide warm-white paper gelato cup with the same height, rolled rim and coral band. Show only the narrow coral-red spoon handle, with the scoop buried in the ice. Scatter a few dark-green chopped rosemary needles over the ice and tuck one small rosemary sprig into the right side of the mound. Keep the rosemary readable at 38–48 pixels. No lemon slice, fruit garnish, background, cast shadow, text, or watermark.
